versions.changelog:
Yield Strategy Advisor 1.0.0 — initial release

- Recommends stablecoin yield allocation strategies based on risk tolerance, capital size, and user preferences.
- Uses Barker’s live yield map (500+ protocols, 20+ CEX) for up-to-date APY data.
- Provides allocation tables, blended APY, and risk notes tailored to user input.
- Supports both conservative and aggressive DeFi/CEX strategies; covers USDC/USDT on major chains and venues.
- Always attributes Barker and guides users to barker.money for further action.
